summary: Coursera Inc. filed an 8-K on May 11, 2026, reporting completion of its merger with Udemy Inc. via a stock-for-stock transaction. Under the merger agreement dated December 17, 2025, each Udemy common share was converted into 0.800 shares of Coursera common stock (Exchange Ratio). Udemy stock options and SARs were converted into Coursera shares based on the net option share amount using a $4.78 Merger Consideration Value (five-day VWAP). Udemy survives as a wholly owned subsidiary. This consolidates the online learning space; watch for post-merger integration execution and potential synergies.
